start.title: [TODO:ko] The Plains of Moab
start.text:
[TODO:ko] Israel rests at the edge of promise.
Your years now end at the river.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Press on and cross with them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The Lord told you not to cross.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You call them with quiet love.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Say nothing and slip away alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] They deserve a farewell.

press_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Honor His Word
press_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] The Jordan is not yours to cross.
Gather the people instead.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You bow and turn back.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] They Need Your Blessing
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Forty years walked together.
Do not leave them in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You raise your staff to call them.

gather_people.title: [TODO:ko] All Israel Listens
gather_people.text:
[TODO:ko] Their faces wait, hushed and still.
What words will you give them?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Recount your own great deeds
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your story is His story.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You speak of manna and sea.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Lift His Name, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] He led you. He fed you. He saved you.
Let them remember Him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your voice softens with truth.

blessing.title: [TODO:ko] A Blessing on the Tribes
blessing.text:
[TODO:ko] You bless each tribe by name.
Your staff trembles with love.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Now appoint your successor
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Leadership must continue.

appoint_joshua.title: [TODO:ko] Who Will Lead Them?
appoint_joshua.text:
[TODO:ko] Joshua stands beside you, steady.
The Lord has chosen him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Choose someone of your own bloodline
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The Lord chose Joshua, not kin.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Cling to leadership a little longer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your time has come to release it.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Spirit and wisdom pass to him.

bloodline_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] His Choice, Not Yours
bloodline_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Joshua has walked beside you all along.
The Lord has named him.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You turn toward Joshua.

cling_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Open Your Hand
cling_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Faithfulness now means letting go.
Give what He asks of you.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your hands come to rest on him.

joshua_blessed.title: [TODO:ko] Be Strong and Courageous
joshua_blessed.text:
[TODO:ko] "The Lord goes before you," you say.
"He will not leave you."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Now climb Mount Nebo as God said
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The mountain waits in the dawn.

ascent.title: [TODO:ko] The Path Up Nebo
ascent.text:
[TODO:ko] Each step is heavy and holy.
At the top, the Lord will speak.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Turn back to the comfort of camp
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] He calls you upward, not back.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your staff steadies your steps.

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] He Waits Above
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] This last climb is His gift to you.
Do not refuse the summit.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You turn your face upward.

summit.title: [TODO:ko] All the Land Before You
summit.text:
[TODO:ko] Valleys and hills shine in gold.
"This is the land," He says.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Grieve that you may not enter
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You have already received enough.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Demand to cross with the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His word is gentle but firm.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Tears of joy fall in silence.

grief_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Look With Joy, Not Sorrow
grief_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] He lets you see what He promised.
This vision is His kindness.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Your heart softens at His mercy.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Trust His Boundary
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Joshua will lead them across.
Your part is complete.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You bow your head in peace.

vision_received.title: [TODO:ko] "You Have Seen It With Your Eyes"
vision_received.text:
[TODO:ko] His voice settles like warm wind.
Your journey draws to its rest.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lie down where He has appointed
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] The mountain holds you gently.

ending_peaceful.title: [TODO:ko] Rest on the Mountain
ending_peaceful.text:
[TODO:ko] You close your eyes in His presence.
The Lord Himself buries His servant.
